label: Ville de Dreux

topology.granularityPolicy: PAN PDC rows remain canonical even when multi-standard equipment produces more PAN rows than the 24 user-facing charge points stated by the official network page.

tariffFamilies.notes: Official Alize table states rotation fee after 2h and free night for subscribers from 21:00 to 08:00 on AC charge points.
The current official Alize tariff table publishes 0.49 EUR/kWh for the citadine DC charge point. No separate lower subscriber DC energy price is published.

Official Alize table publishes 0.54 EUR/kWh for the 150 kW Express station and 0.00 EUR/min rotation component. Applied to every PAN connector row on an Express station, because pricing is station-class based.

exclusions: Only PAN stations matching R-Mob, INSEE 28134 and explicit Ville de Dreux station naming are eligible.
Other R-Mob stations in Eure-et-Loir or other departments never inherit the Dreux tariff.
The 10 EUR/month Ville de Dreux subscription is opt-in and affects ranking only when selected.
Parking fees remain separate from charging and are not included in these offers.
PAN IRVE remains the sole physical inventory.
Do not equate PAN connector/PDC rows with the official count of 24 user-facing charge points.
